description: Live web search for AI agents, powered by Brave Search: send a natural-language query and get ranked results with titles, URLs, descriptions and result age from Brave's independent web index, ready to cite, summarize or read further. For research, fact-checking, news and docs lookups, price and competitor checks inside agent workflows. No Brave account, API key or subscription needed: pay per call in USDC via x402.
name: search-brave
